name: Gouda
siboNotes: Aged hard cheeses like Gouda are naturally low in lactose due to the aging process, making them well-tolerated for most SIBO patients.
preparationTips: Choose aged Gouda (12+ months) for lowest lactose content
Store properly wrapped in refrigerator to maintain quality
Allow to come to room temperature before serving for best flavor
Grate fresh rather than buying pre-shredded for better taste
nutritionalHighlights: Excellent source of calcium for bone health
Contains vitamin K2 for cardiovascular support
